About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation: $25 – $35 per hour

data.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level English speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to English.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in English as spoken in the US.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

data.description:
Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, and looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design, we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media - France to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. You’ll shape how Deliveroo shows up across social channels, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, platform-native, creatively ambitious and connected to our wider marketing and business strategy.

Sitting within our Global Brand Marketing function and reporting to the Director, Social, Cultural and Earned Media, you’ll work closely with our France Marketing team, agency partners and colleagues across Brand, Media, Integrated Marketing, Consumer Communications, Commercial, Grocery and Retail.

This role is open to applicants based in France or England and follows a hybrid working model, with three days a week in either our Paris or London HQ.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining our Social, Culture and Earned Media team, connecting people with Deliveroo through the moments, partnerships and experiences that matter most. You’ll balance strategic ownership with hands-on leadership, setting the long-term direction for social in France while ensuring our day-to-day presence is timely, engaging and effective.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Set the direction for social in France, leading our strategy and roadmap across always-on activity, brand campaigns, commercial priorities, cultural moments and reactive opportunities, with a focus on building brand equity, consideration and cultural relevance.

  • Turn global thinking into locally relevant work, translating brand and campaign strategies into social-first ideas, formats and executions that resonate with French audiences and feel native to each platform.

  • Lead our French social presence, overseeing channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, as well as the content calendar, tone of voice and community engagement approach.

  • Bring teams and partners together, acting as the senior social lead for France and collaborating across local Marketing, Brand, Media, Commercial, PR, Global and European Social teams to embed social early in campaign planning and share learnings across markets.

  • Lead creative delivery and partnerships, managing agency partners and influencer activity from briefing and production through approvals and launch, ensuring work meets the right creative, strategic and operational standards.

  • Keep Deliveroo connected to culture, monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations.

  • Turn performance into progress, establishing effective ways of working, reporting on social performance and community insights, and using those learnings to optimise content, campaigns and channel strategy. You’ll also coach junior team members and contribute to raising social standards across markets.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Deep social and cultural expertise, with strong knowledge of major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, alongside an excellent understanding of French culture, internet behaviour, creators, communities and trends.

  • Flawless written French and excellent English communication skills, with the judgement to develop distinctive, accurate and culturally relevant brand communications.

  • Strong strategic and creative judgement, with experience developing social strategies and campaigns that build brand visibility, engagement and cultural relevance, from initial strategy and briefing through execution, optimisation and reporting.

  • A data-informed approach, with a strong understanding of social metrics and the ability to translate performance and community insights into clear recommendations that improve future work.

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with experience managing agency partners, creative development, stakeholders and competing priorities, alongside the ability to coach junior colleagues, influence effectively and operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team.

🔧 High autonomy to build and deliver impactful work

🌱 Support to learn and grow, from L&D programmes to mentoring

💚 Wellbeing matters, with resources and benefits designed to support our people

🌍 A place to belong, with a global workforce and active employee communities

Our benefits differ by country and include support across areas such as healthcare, wellbeing, parental leave, pensions and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Your recruiter can tell you more about the benefits available in your location.

The Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that gives you the opportunity to show us your experience, thinking and approach. The process will typically include conversations with our recruitment team and key stakeholders across Brand Marketing, giving you the chance to learn more about the role and team while we explore your social media expertise, strategic thinking, creative judgement, leadership and collaboration style.

Your recruiter will share the full interview process and what to expect at each stage.

Why Deliveroo

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Customer Care team supports Deliveroo’s customers, riders, and restaurant partners—delivering thoughtful, efficient, and empathetic service at every interaction. Whether solving live issues, building proactive support experiences, or driving continuous improvement through data and insights, we are champions of service excellence across our entire marketplace. If you care deeply about people and love making things better—this is the place for you.

As an Operations Manager - based in the Paris office on a hybrid basis - you’ll be finding solutions to some of our biggest challenges to deliver a seamless customer experience in the French market, thus directly contributing to one of the key pillars of Deliveroo’s strategy within the Operations function.

We are looking for a fully-autonomous critical thinker who is able to own a market level area, instrumental in identifying growth & quality objectives, build plans with strong modelling skills, and lead their delivery. This comes with a best in class analytical mindset, deep understanding of the competition and cross-functional influence.

Key responsibilities include:

  1. Own complex logistic and financial strategic initiatives, collaborate with various business units, and contribute to continuous improvement in our delivery network

  2. Own part of our network efficiency: define market-winning strategies at a hyper-local level, considering factors that make us the most attractive food delivery option, improve service levels across Operations and balance cost priorities with growth and service level delivery. Create models & frameworks to industrialise our monitoring and support our operations

  3. Improve the customer and rider proposition: join a team dedicated to delivering better outcomes for riders partners and our customers.

Qualities we’re looking for:

  1. Analytical and impact oriented mindset: “doer” attitude with appetite to solve real-world problems and seeking for short & mid term impact, through data analysis, modelling and innovative solution implementations (eg test and learn approach)

  2. Good communicator with strong stakeholder management skills: become a subject matter expert and trusted advisor through exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to write synthetic documents and influence a senior audience

  3. Insightful, proactive and engaged: capable of both getting “the big picture” (understanding interdependencies and implications of topics with other parts of the business) and deep diving in detailed dynamics at play behind a trend/an anecdote. Proactively collaborates with colleagues across functions and taps into stakeholders’ business knowledge to understand trends, and spot opportunities for customer experience improvement. Able to keep track of competition’s moves and identify impact and opportunities for our business.

Profile

  • 3-4 years of experience working in a high-paced and project-based organisation, for example at a tech startup or in management consultancy

  • Strong experience in quantitative and qualitative analytics (excel modelling, database crunching) and excellent mastery of Google Suite/Microsoft Office. Knowledge of SQL is a plus

  • Track record in autonomously structuring, coordinating and executing projects

  • Prioritises effectively between tasks, favours 80/20 approaches and can manage multiple projects concurrently

  • Excellent (oral / written) communication in both English and French. Track record in presenting to a senior audience and influencing decision making

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and thrives in a collaborative environment

     

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Vos principales missions :

  • Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés dans des secteurs matures, nécessitant une réelle expertise et une attention particulière.

  • Créer un partenariat privilégié et durable en apportant votre expertise Food Tech, en tant qu’expert(e) de votre zone/ville.

  • Optimiser la rentabilité de votre portefeuille et proposer un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme avec l’appui de la data.

  • Soyez un expert de votre zone et assurer le rayonnement de Deliveroo grâce à une vision 360 : account management, sales, marketing, opérations.

  • Analyser la performance de votre portefeuille et prendre les mesures adéquates. Faire des recommandations directes au Client Partner, faire preuve d’agilité et d’ouverture à la nouveauté. Deliveroo est une entreprise en mouvement, avec des outils et options à déployer à un rythme soutenu.

  • Suggérer et mettre en œuvre des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles adaptées à votre portefeuille.

  • Suivre de près les opérations pour optimiser l’expérience à la fois des restaurants partenaires et des clients.

Votre expérience et vos qualités :

  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience minimum sur un poste similaire.

  • Capacité à négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre les actions nécessaires pour maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociation d’outils commerciaux, etc.) et atteindre les objectifs (OKRs).

  • Capacités d’analyse data afin d’y tirer des axes de croissance nécessaires au développement de vos comptes.

  • Capacité à garder le contrôle de son portefeuille Partenaires, à observer les tendances du marché et à fournir des retours en temps réel à ses partenaires et à son manager.

  • Expertise terrain : proche de vos partenaires, vous êtes capable d’assurer une veille concurrentielle qualitative sur votre portefeuille et votre secteur.

  • Capacité à convaincre et à influencer vos partenaires pour atteindre les objectifs fixés, tout en respectant les valeurs de Deliveroo.

  • Proactivité et capacité à tirer des conclusions des résultats de vos actions pour faire des recommandations pertinentes aux partenaires.

  • Compréhension et appropriation rapide des objectifs à atteindre, avec autonomie et détermination.

  • Capacité à mettre en place des actions personnalisées et cohérentes avec les besoins des partenaires et les directives managériales.

  • Capacité à identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance commerciale et opérationnelle sur l’ensemble de votre portefeuille dans une logique d’excellence de service.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit/parlé) pour défendre un point de vue et communiquer efficacement.

  • Capacité à construire des relations commerciales durables afin de faire de Deliveroo la référence de la “food” aux yeux de nos partenaires.

Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

data.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're hiring a Local Lead, Creative Campaigns to join Deliveroo's Global Marketing team on a 8-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave from mid-late September 2026.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

Reporting into the Director of Creative Strategy & Campaigns, you'll lead the development and delivery of global brand campaigns and activations across Deliveroo's markets, partnering closely with teams across Marketing, Product, Research, Media, Social and our in-house Creative Studio. Given the Global nature of the position, we are looking for a candidate who is bi-lingual in French and English at minimum; ideally Italian too.

This role comes at an exciting point in our campaign calendar. You'll be stepping into an active programme of high-profile work, so we're looking for someone who can quickly build context, establish strong relationships and confidently take ownership of multiple projects from the outset. You'll be supported by an experienced team, but you'll be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions and maintaining momentum in a fast-moving environment.

This role follows our hybrid working policy, with three days per week in our Paris HQ. Given the Global nature of the team and campaigns we work on, travel to our offices in London, Milan and UAE may be an opportunity too.

What you'll be doing

Lead global brand campaigns

Own the end-to-end development of key global campaigns - from defining creative objectives and writing briefs through to creative development, production, localisation and rollout across our markets (UK, France, Italy, Belgium and UAE). You'll work closely with Integrated Marketing, Media, Insights, PR and Social teams to ensure campaigns are creatively distinctive and commercially effective.

International team leadership

You will lead a team of 3, developing campaigns across different markets and with different culture, language and local market context. You will inspire across these geographical boundaries and foster an inclusive team culture. Working with your local teams, you will aspire to learn about the different customer behaviours and culture in our markets, to ensure our marketing is as effective as possible.

Drive creative excellence

Partner with our Creative Director, in-house Creative Studio and external creative & media agencies to develop bold, channel-appropriate creative that strengthens Deliveroo's brand. You'll champion high creative standards while balancing speed, quality and operational excellence. Transcreation for different markets is a key part of this role, so you will look for ideas that can flex for different audiences and languages.

Deliver integrated production

Lead complex multi-channel productions across TV, OOH, digital, social, radio and in-app experiences, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time, on budget and to a consistently high standard.

Measure and improve performance

Work with Marketing Effectiveness and Insights teams to evaluate campaign performance, identify learnings and translate those into actionable recommendations that continuously improve our creative output.

Build capability across the business

Develop creative frameworks, playbooks and best practice that help global and local teams deliver stronger campaigns more consistently. Foster close collaboration across functions and markets to ensure ideas travel well while remaining locally relevant.

 
 

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with excellent campaign delivery and thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment.

You'll bring:

  • 8+ years proven experience working in a similar role and delivering impactful global or multi-market campaigns with significant experience in creative strategy, development of big ideas through to an integrated plan across a brand’s ecosystem

  • Experience in delivering TTL production (including TV, OOH, digital, social, radio)

  • Experience managing creative agencies

  • Bi-lingual in French and English at minimum; ideally Italian too.

  • International team leadership experience

  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage global and cross-departmental stakeholders and partners

  • Attention to detail

  • Experience communicating with senior leadership

  • A self-starter attitude with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrix environment

  • Ability to navigate ambitious and complex projects

  • Agency experience is a plus, but not mandatory

  • Experience working at or with a retail/eComm/tech/FMCG company preferred

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day
 Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
 Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role
 Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
 Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

As we accelerate toward our 2027 ambition, Global Accounts are central to our future success. We are building a team that sets the standard for strategic partnership management — combining senior commercial leadership, rigorous execution, and organisational depth.

The Role

As Head of Global Accounts, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for the commercial relationship with France's most strategic restaurant brands. Your team currently consists of 7 people: Key Account Managers who own brand HQ relationships, and a Client Partner (mid-manager) who manages a team of Key Account Associates covering franchisees across the territory. You report to the Director of Enterprise & Key Accounts, France, and are based in Paris (this is a hybrid role).

You are the senior commercial owner for your portfolio — accountable for revenue growth, partner satisfaction, and team excellence. Beyond day-to-day account management, you will play a central role in aligning the organisation to strategic priorities: from contract structuring and joint business planning, to supporting Deliveroo's city expansion strategy by securing anchor restaurant partners in new and relaunching markets.

Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams.

The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan’s effectiveness against Deliveroo France’s marketing and business objectives.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integrated Marketing Planning & Business Performance — France

  • Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market.

  • Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar.

  • Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan.

  • Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies.

  • Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans.

  • Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative.

2. Orchestrating 360° Campaigns

  • Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines.

  • Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market.

  • Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams.

  • Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision.

3. Tracking, Performance & Governance

  • Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins.

  • Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs.

  • Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected.

  • Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners.

  • Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans.

4. Agencies & Partnerships

  • Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval.

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning.

  • Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners.

Ways of Working

  • Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence.

  • Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities.

  • Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders.

Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation.

Key Skills

  • Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives.

  • Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations.

  • Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution.

  • Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency.

  • Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations.

  • Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies.

  • Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market.

Success Measures

  • One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams.

  • Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity.

  • Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans.

  • Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated.

  • Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France’s marketing and business objectives.

  • Clear stakeholder visibility on priorities, risks, decisions and results.

Why This Role?

This role offers unique exposure to Deliveroo France’s strategic marketing challenges, working directly with local leadership and central functional teams. It provides a strong platform for progression into broader Integrated Marketing responsibilities.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Deine Aufgaben

Bloombase baut die führende ERP-Plattform für Cannabis-Apotheken in Deutschland. Gegründet mit dem Full-Stack-Know-how von SnapNext und dem Branchenrückhalt von Cannamedical – einem der größten Cannabis-Konzerne im deutschsprachigen Raum – entwickeln wir eine B2B-Software, die das Cannabis-Business bei uns und unseren Kunden grundlegend neu strukturiert. 
Wir sind klein, bewegen uns schnell und treffen Entscheidungen pragmatisch. Du steigst früh ein, gestaltest die Company aktiv mit und arbeitest in einem modernen Startup-Umfeld – mit der Sicherheit und dem Rückhalt einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe im Rücken. 

  • Du entwickelst unsere ERP-Kernmodule mit – Inventarverwaltung, Auftragsabwicklung per Stapelverarbeitung, digitale Rezeptabwicklung und rollenbasierte Dashboards – über den gesamten Stack hinweg
  • Du baust und pflegst die Schnittstellen, über die eine einzige Anbindung unsere Kunden mit allen Telemedizin-Plattformen und Versanddienstleistern (z. B. DHL, UPS) verbindet
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Audit-Sicherheit, lückenlose Protokollierung und DSGVO-Konformität sauber im Code verankert sind – bei uns Kernanforderung, kein Nachgedanke
  • Du schreibst wartbaren, getesteten Code, nimmst an Code Reviews teil und entwickelst unsere Standards mit weiter
  • Du behältst die Skalierbarkeit im Blick, damit die Software auch bei steigendem Bestellvolumen schnell und stabil bleibt



Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Stack: Frontend mit React, Backend mit Node.js (NestJS) und durchgängig JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken und Datenmodellierung

About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Contact

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

data.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Marketing-, Produkt-, Finance- und Supply-Chain-Daten leben bei uns heute in getrennten Systemen. Gleichzeitig bleiben viele unserer besten KI-Ideen noch im Pilot-Stadium. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du legst unsere technische und datenseitige Basis und etablierst AI-First-Prozesse im Tagesgeschäft – hands-on, eigenverantwortlich und ohne großes Entwicklerteam im Rücken.

  • Eine Wahrheit für alle Teams: Du führst Marketing-, Produkt-, Finance- und Supply-Chain-Daten in einer einheitlichen Cloud-Datenplattform zusammen. Ziel: Fachteams steuern ihre wichtigsten KPIs vollautomatisiert - weg von Excel-Silos, hin zu Self-Service-BI.

  • AI-First Prozessautomatisierung: Du verankerst konkrete, produktiv genutzte AI-Use-Cases in unseren fünf Kernbereichen (Marketing, Produkt, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance) - von automatisiertem Marketing-Reporting über KI-gestützte Qualitätssicherung bis zu zentralisiertem Finance-Reporting. So reduzierst du manuelle Aufwände spürbar.

  • Schnittstelle & Sparring: Du arbeitest eng mit Teamleads und Geschäftsführung, um Business-Anforderungen direkt in pragmatische, technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

Wir möchten Shop-Kompetenz zunehmend in-house aufbauen - mit dem Ziel, unabhängiger von unserer aktuellen Agentur zu werden.


Das steckt in deiner Haut

  • Relevante Praxiserfahrung: ca. 4–7 Jahre im Daten- und E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise D2C.

  • Data-Architektur: Starke Expertise im Aufbau von unified Data-Architekturen und Self-Service-BI. Du hast Datenquellen schon einmal end-to-end in eine Plattform zusammengeführt.

  • Tech-enabled Automatisierung: Praxiserprobte KI-/Prozessautomatisierung, die du eigenständig produktiv gebracht hast.

Nice to have

data.title: Head of Data / Tech / E-COM (m/w/d)

data.description:
Deine Rolle

Du bist unser zentraler Finance Point of Contact - die Person, bei der alle Fäden zusammenlaufen. Du verantwortest das komplette operative Finance, baust dir die Prozesse dafür selbst auf und automatisierst, was sich automatisieren lässt. 

Du bekommst echte Ownership, maximale Autonomie und die Chance, Finance so zu gestalten, wie du es für richtig hältst.

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt. 

Aufgaben:

Operatives Finance

  • Kreditoren- & Debitorenbuchhaltung: Rechnungslauf, Belegprüfung, Mahnwesen.

  • Zahlungsverkehr & Banken: Tagesgeschäft, Kontoauszüge, Abstimmungen.

  • Reisekosten & Spesen: Teamausgaben effizient über moderne Tools (z. B. Spendesk).

  • Umsatzabgleich: App Store, Google Play und PayPal mit Kontoeingängen abstimmen.

Steuerberatung & Behörden

  • Zentrale Anlaufstelle und enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerberatungskanzlei.

  • Ansprechperson bei Betriebsprüfungen und Wirtschaftsprüfer-Audits.

Zusammenarbeit mit den Departments

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen, allen voran Sales: Deal-Abstimmungen, Provisions-/Bonus-Themen, laufender Austausch zu Zahlen.

Payroll & Vergütung

  • Sales-Bonus-Berechnung und Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung vorbereiten, prüfen und freigeben – inkl. internationale Payroll (u. a. Deel).

Abschlüsse & Compliance

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB, Budgetierung/Financial Planning.

Prozesse & Systeme

  • Einführung von Scopevisio als neuem Finance-System, Pflege der Stammdaten.

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse.

Automatisierung & KI

  • Du entscheidest, wo sich Automatisierung wirklich lohnt, und baust entsprechende Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Tools.

  • Aktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools, um wiederkehrende Aufgaben effizienter zu machen.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährig, idealerweise als Alleinverantwortliche:r über mehrere Finance-Disziplinen hinweg (Buchhaltung, Payroll, Abschlüsse).

  • Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware wie DATEV ist Pflicht; Erfahrung mit Tools wie Scopevisio, Spendesk oder HubSpot (als CRM/Buchungstool im Zusammenspiel mit Sales) ist von Vorteil.

  • Mindset: Digital- und AI-affin, nutzt KI-Tools aktiv zur Effizienzsteigerung.

  • Arbeitsweise: Selbstständig, proaktiv, mit echtem Ownership.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

  • Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

  • Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

data.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Gestalte die Digitalisierung des Public Sector von morgen!
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, wie sich die deutsche Verwaltung modernisiert – sondern dein ganzes Know-how bei der Digitalisierung von Verwaltungsleistungen einsetzen? Sei es bei der Mitwirkung, bei der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller OZG-Verwaltungsleistungen nach dem Einer-für-Alle-Prinzip oder der Abschaffung aufwändiger Nachweispflichten für Bürger:innen und Unternehmen durch konsequente Umsetzung des Once Only-Prinzips durch die Registermodernisierung. Sei dabei als Consultant Public Sector (all genders) und das aus Hamburg heraus mit der Option auf Homeoffice!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du bist Teil der Consulting-Unit und verantwortlich für gestaltest (IT-)Beratungsprojekte mit
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden aus dem Public Sector in Projekten zur Umsetzung von Digitalisierungsvorhaben  
  • Du unterstützt in der Gestaltung von Strategien, Organisationen und Prozessen von Behörden der Bundes-, Landes- und Kommunalebene 
  • Du erarbeitest gemeinsam im Projektteam die Anforderungen des Kunden und entwirfst innovative Lösungsstrategien und -konzepte
  • Du bildest dich kontinuierlich fort durch Fortbildungen und teaminternen Wissenstransfer


Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Politikwissenschaft, Verwaltungswissenschaft, Verwaltungsinformatik, Rechtswissenschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik – oder einen anderen Hintergrund, der dich für das Tätigkeitsfeld qualifiziert. Auf bestimmte Studienrichtungen legen wir uns dabei bewusst nicht fest
  • Erste Praxis in der Beratung oder im IT-Projektmanagement – besonders freuen wir uns über Berührungspunkte mit der öffentlichen Verwaltung
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Projektplanung und -steuerung; PMFlex kennst du idealerweise bereits oder möchtest dich schnell darin einarbeiten
  • Freude daran, die Einführung neuer IT-Lösungen von der Vorbereitung über Pilotierung und Tests bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live zu begleiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür dafür, unterschiedliche Nutzer und Stakeholder bei Veränderungen mitzunehmen – ob in Workshops, Informationsveranstaltungen, Sprechstunden oder Schulungen
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und in Leitfäden, Handbüchern oder Unterlagen für die Gremienbeteiligung auf den Punkt zu bringen

data.description:
Über tonies:

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.
Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.


Du als Teil von tonies:

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben.
Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten.
Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

IT-Strategie & Architektur

  • Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit.
  • Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce).
  • Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX.
IT-Governance & Sicherheit
  • Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal).
  • Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.).
  • Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans.
  • Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende.
  • Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen.


Was wir uns von dir wünschen:

  • Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich).
  • Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards.
  • Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“.
  • Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365).
  • Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
  • Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten.
  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus).


Warum tonies?

Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt. 

Wir freuen uns auf deine digitale Bewerbung!

Ketsia Dinzala
People & Culture

data.description:
Wir sind Fabio und Luis, die Gründer von Hunderunde. Wir haben Hunderunde gestartet, weil wir überzeugt sind: Hunde verdienen natürliche Ernährung, die wirklich hilft. Unsere pflanzenbasierten Toppings unterstützen Verdauung, Haut & Fell und das allgemeine Wohlbefinden von Hunden, tierärztlich mitentwickelt und mit echtem Anspruch an Wirksamkeit. Für uns ist das keine reine Business-Idee: Ein Teil dessen, was wir verdienen, geht an ein Straßenhund-Rettungsprojekt in Rumänien, Tierschutz gehört für uns genauso zur Marke wie das Produkt selbst.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Reise so zu gestalten, dass mehr Menschen bleiben, statt nach der ersten Bestellung wieder zu verschwinden.

  • Klaviyo als dein Zuhause: Du baust, testest und optimierst unsere E-Mail-Flows (Post-Purchase, Win-Back, Wirkungsfenster-Check-ins bei Woche 2 & 6, Kündigungs-Flows) und Kampagnen. Segmentierung ist für dich kein Buzzword, sondern Alltag.
  • WhatsApp-Marketing: Du entwickelst unseren WhatsApp-Kanal als zweiten Lifecycle-Kanal weiter – von Onboarding-Sequenzen bis zu Sparplan-Reminder und Winback.
  • Sparplan-Steuerung: Du bist verantwortlich dafür, dass unser Abo wächst und weniger Menschen kündigen. Du kennst die technischen Grenzen von ReCharge (z. B. bei Rabatt-Mechaniken für Bestandskunden) und findest trotzdem smarte Lösungen – Pause-Angebote statt Kündigung, Win-Back-Flows für reversible Absprünge, Intervall-Anpassungen.

data.description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization. Our customers map reality, with its levers and constraints, into a model, and we run large-scale combinatorial optimization over the critical decisions in their value chain. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

Most optimization software fails in the same place. Not in the solver, but in the gap between what a company actually does and what the model assumes. Somebody has to sit with the people who plan today, understand how they really decide, and turn that into something a machine can compute.

That is this role, and you do it hands on. You take the customer's planning problem apart, you build the model yourself, in code, on their data, and you stay with it until their management trusts the result enough to act on it. Then you bring back the part that should stop being project work and become product.

Most of this happens at your desk in Cologne, with days at the customer's site when the decisive conversations happen. You are the shortest path between our product and reality. What does not survive at a customer does not work.

We will not sugarcoat it: the data arrives messy, the first model is rarely the right one, and some weeks a customer deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • The customer's decision problem. Sit with the people who plan today, understand capacities, costs, lead times and the constraints nobody wrote down, and turn it into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. Inventory, scheduling, supply shortages, order prioritization: the decisions that determine whether a plant stays competitive.
  • The customer's model, end to end. You own it from the first conversation to the version that runs in production. Our math and OR team owns the engine and the solver core underneath; you own what is built on top of it for this customer.
  • The data it runs on. ERP and Excel exports, inconsistent and incomplete. You get them into shape yourself and notice when numbers cannot be right before the customer does.
  • The result, all the way to trust. Not a demo. A model that is used, questioned, corrected and used again.
  • The feedback loop into the product. You see the same problem at the second and third customer before anyone else does. You make the call at the customer, and you argue the case for what belongs in the platform.
  • Your work, from the first line of code to a model the customer runs. Nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

How we work

Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your work end to end: you build it, you ship it to production yourself, you run it.

Feedback runs both ways and continuously, in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals, communicate proactively, and flag early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.

We review each other's work, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

Requirements

  • You have built quantitative models for real operations problems and taken them into production, not into a slide deck. Optimization, simulation, or a combination of both.
  • You have done this more than once, end to end, and at least one of those models still runs without you in the room.
  • You still write the production code yourself, today.
  • Before you build anything, you can name the few assumptions and constraints that will decide the result, and you clear them with the customer first. Customers know their goal, they rarely know which constraint binds.
  • You are comfortable in front of a plant manager or a controller, and you can leave that room knowing what the model has to do. You explain what the model does to people who will never read the code, and to people who will.
  • You work with messy industrial data as a matter of course. Cleaning it is part of the problem, not beneath the job.
  • Python at production quality.
  • You have worked inside a team with shared standards, not only on your own projects.
  • German and English, both at a level where you can run a customer meeting and write a specification. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
  • NRW-based (Cologne office). Our customers sit across the DACH region and the decisive conversations happen on site, even though most of the work with them is online. Expect travel, not every week, but on a regular basis.

Nice to have: operations research background · optimization tooling such as Gurobi, OR-Tools or Pyomo · production planning, supply chain, inventory or logistics domain knowledge · experience in a consulting or forward deployed setting · early-stage startup experience.

This role is not for you if you want to hand over after the concept, if you would rather advise than be accountable for whether the thing works, if a plant floor is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, or if you are waiting for the next task to be handed to you.

Benefits

  • Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast, and customers measure in euros what your work changed. They tell you, directly.
  • Ownership. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
  • The people next to you. The math and OR team on the engine, the CTO on the platform, and the founders on where this goes.
  • Shaping. You make the call at the customer, and you argue the case for what becomes product. That argument is one of the most consequential in the company right now.
  • Feedback speed. You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you.
  • Compensation. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
  • The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: a 20-minute first call; a technical conversation with two of us; a hands-on challenge of about three hours on a real planning problem with messy data, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it; then the team, online and then in person. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about a system you built for one specific customer, and what you would have had to change to make it work for the next one.

Distributed energy resources are transforming the global grid, and our cloud platform sits right at the center of it. Every day, our Cloud EMS and core APIs power tens of thousands of connected systems, serving as the foundational infrastructure that engineering teams rely on to build the future of clean energy. If you thrive on stability, scalability, and high-stakes system design, this is your place to #makeamark.

At gridX, we build with purpose and live by a clear set of values: we #get shit done, continuously push boundaries to #make a mark, #appreciate with all your heart, and welcome everyone to #come as you are. Ready to power the future of energy infrastructure? Apply now to join our team as a Senior Backend Engineer!

data.description:
Your impact at gridX

As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platforms Team, you’ll play a key role in bridging the gap between external cloud ecosystems and the gridX platform. As part of the Cloud Connector team, your work is the bridge between the gridX platform and the outside world. You will build and maintain the backend services that allow us to seamlessly integrate with external energy providers. Your code will turn complex, varied external APIs into standardized, reliable connections that the rest of our engineering organization relies on. By developing robust APIs and smart integration tools, you empower gridX to onboard new cloud assets faster, making energy management seamless for our customers and platform partners alike.
Are you ready to #makeamark, #getshitdone, and build the future of energy? Apply now and join our mission!

Please note: We only accept applications from candidates who are currently located in Germany.


How you can contribute to gridX

What you’ll work on

  • Integrations with partners: Your primary focus is seamlessly integrating various cloud providers into our ecosystem. This involves implementing and maintaining Go services that abstract away provider-specific edge cases, allowing us to reliably gather measurements and send control commands. You'll work closely with API specs, frequently leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate your implementation and review cycles.
  • Fast scaling: You’ll engineer solutions for a fast-scaling platform handling around 20.000 cloud-connected assets. With our managed fleet growing over 80%  the past 6 months, you’ll play a critical role in designing architecture that handles heavy telemetry and real-time control at scale.
  • Cross-team Collaboration: The Cloud Connector is the critical bridge connecting physical devices to gridX’s wider platform architecture. You'll build the cloud integrations that link assets to our platform, ingest asset data for various services, and route real-time execution commands back to the assets via cloud providers.

We use AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows extensively, from code generation and review to spec analysis and test creation. You'll be expected to leverage these tools effectively and help actively shape our evolving engineering culture.

Day-to-day, that means

  • Implementing new cloud integrations based on API documentation, OAuth specifications, and webhook contracts.
  • Evolving the integration framework, refactoring event-processing chains, migrating data stores, and shaping the abstractions that make future integrations simpler.
  • Debugging distributed pipeline failures using structured logs, distributed traces, and metrics, across OAuth flows, webhook processing, and event delivery.
  • Writing tests that cover provider API contracts, webhook edge cases, command delivery reliability, and distributed failure modes.
  • Contributing to API specifications (TypeSpec/OpenAPI, protobuf/gRPC) that connects to downstream gridX services and external partners.
  • Collaborating with cloud API teams, Product Owners, Platform Engineers, and Energy Domain Experts.


This is how you and your application stand out

What matters beyond code

  • Pragmatism over perfection: You ship working software, iterate, and don't gold-plate.
  • Product thinking: You care about what your code enables for users and partners, not just the code itself.
  • Interest in the domain: You find renewable energy hardware fascinating if you're curious. You don't need prior energy sector expertise, but genuine interest is important.
  • End-to-End ownership: You follow through from “it compiles” to “it runs in production.” You embrace a “you build it, you run it” mindset, deploying, operating, and monitoring your own services on our Kubernetes cluster using automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Tech Stack: You work with Go • Linux • Docker • Kubernetes • gRPC • Protocol Buffers • PostgreSQL • AWS • CI/CD • Nix

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with electrical engineering concepts (power, current, phases)
  • Familiarity with running Go backend workloads in Kubernetes
  • Experience with IoT or embedded-adjacent systems
  • Contributions to open-source Go projects
  • German language skills (team is mixed EN/DE, English is working language)


Why gridX

We believe great work happens when people have the freedom, support, and flexibility to do their best work. That’s why we offer a benefits package designed to support your work, wellbeing, development, and life outside of work.

  • Flexible & mobile working: Work remotely for up to 70 days per year from anywhere in the EU and selected countries outside the EU.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of vacation plus an additional half day off on December 24 and December 31.
  • Health & sports: Get a €30 monthly allowance for Urban Sports Club or EGYM Wellpass, plus access to company health management and mental health support.
  • Personal development: Benefit from cross-functional coaching, e-learning platforms, and an annual development budget of €1,500.
  • Employee discounts: Enjoy exclusive offers and discounts through gridX Corporate Benefits.
  • JobRad: Lease a bike through our JobRad program and combine sustainable commuting with an active lifestyle.
  • Company pension plan: Receive a fair monthly employer contribution to your company pension plan.
  • Mobility support: Get a €30 monthly subsidy for your public transportation ticket.
  • Modern workplace: Work from our offices in the heart of Aachen or Munich with modern IT equipment of your choice.
  • Team events & culture: Experience the gridX culture through regular team events, plus an additional €100 annual budget for department events.
  • Birthday donation: We donate €20 to a charity of your choice on your birthday.
  • Sabbatical option: Take an extended break for personal projects, travel, further education, or simply to recharge.
