data.description:
Start your very own journey – with HolidayCheck!

At HolidayCheck, everything revolves around making vacations better – together. We’re not only enabling the best time of the year for our travelers, but also creating an inspiring work environment for our team in our modern offices in Munich or Bottighofen. 

We live our company values every day: as #TeamHolidayCheck, we build trust, take ownership, and love what we do – all for the perfect holiday experience. 

As (Senior) CRM Automation & Lifecycle Manager (all genders), you own the customer relationship across the entire lifecycle – from first inspiration to rebooking. You don’t think in one-off campaigns, but in intelligent journeys: who should be contacted, when, through which channel, with which message, and based on which data signals? 

You connect strategy, data, technology, and content into one coherent system and make sure our CRM activities create measurable impact on journey performance, retention, rebooking, and Customer Lifetime Value. 


Your Tasks

  • Design and implement automated customer journeys end-to-end, from strategy to go-live in our CDP, including trigger logic, channel orchestration, and A/B testing
  • Define contact strategies and frequency logic across the customer lifecycle for email, push, and WhatsApp
  • Translate RFM, CLV, and churn scores into concrete segmentation, prioritization, and reactivation actions
  • Own and optimize journey-level performance based on KPIs such as open and click rates, unsubscribes, communication volume, conversion rates and revenue
  • Own lifecycle and retention KPIs such as rebooking, churn, engagement, and Customer Lifetime Value, and derive clear optimization measures
  • Translate requirements and business goals from our Business Units into concrete CRM measures, align dependencies across teams, and clearly represent CRM priorities
  • Treat the HolidayCheck Club as a core part of the customer relationship and ensure it is structurally embedded across the customer journey
  • Coordinate closely with Content & Campaign, Analytics & Data, and Tech & Automation to ensure journeys, data, content, and technology work as one system
  • Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities to scale and continuously improve our lifecycle communication


What you bring

  • At least 6 years of experience in CRM or lifecycle management, including at least 3 years in a strategic role with end-to-end responsibility for customer journeys and their performance
  • Proven ability to make segmentation, channel, contact strategy, and prioritization decisions based on data rather than gut feeling
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of email, push notifications, and WhatsApp as CRM channels, including their respective mechanics, use cases, and customer experience implications
  • Hands-on experience with a CDP or marketing automation platform such as Bloomreach, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Emarsys
  • Solid understanding of journey, retention, CLV, and churn metrics, plus experience working with BI dashboards or basic SQL
  • Experience translating business requirements into scalable CRM strategies and measures while balancing priorities across different stakeholders
  • Strategic and entrepreneurial thinking combined with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset
  • Active use of AI tools in your daily work and enthusiasm for identifying and implementing automation opportunities
  • Native-level German (C2) with an excellent feel for tone and customer-centric communication, as you’ll help shape how HolidayCheck speaks to our customers


Our “All Inclusive Package” for you

Workation & Flexibility

data.title: Praktikant:in - Sales/Marketing (m/w/d)

data.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Your mission

As the (Senior / Staff) IT Operations Specialist, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for the holding/central employees at 1KOMMA5.  This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in the holding will know their Tech Business Partner by name, and have trust to include them in all technical discussions that improve their productivity. You are accountable for the holdings success.

The average day of a (Senior / Staff) IT Operations SpecialistThe role is divided into 3 key value areas

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2  and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround.  Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop.  You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability. 

  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, setup n8n flows).

  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications.  There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Your profile

  • Minimum of 10+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field

  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis

  • Proven ability to lead a small and assertive team

  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects

  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications (Zoho CRM is a huge plus) surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security

  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity

  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS,  AppScript, Python and Cursor AI

  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus

  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN)

  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management

  • Strong people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions

  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology

  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus

  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree - certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus

  • German and English written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel primarily to 1KOMMA5 the other holding locations (Munich & Hamburg)


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. 
 
As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs.  
  • Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements. 
  • Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations.  
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles. 
  • Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations. 
  • Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction.  
  • Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations. 
  • Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers. 
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers.  
  • Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings. 

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline. 
  • At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support. 
  • In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics. 
  • Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements. 
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python. 
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry. 
  • Familiarity with small satellite systems and their unique requirements 

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Background in technical sales, marketing, or customer solution development is a plus.
  • Experience in crafting technical solutions for customer proposals, demonstrating an understanding of customer requirements and aligning product capabilities accordingly.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality.
 
What is our mission?
 
We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.
 
What are we offering?
 
Impact; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.
Personal Growth; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager.
Experience; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.
Delight; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.
Community; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.
 
What are we searching for?
 
Leadership, you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.
Communication, you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.
Problem Solving, you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.
Teamwork, you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them. 
Listening, despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.
Entrepreneurial Spirit, rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?
 

What You Will Do
  • Define the why, when, and what of the products our engineering team builds, leading cross-functional teams from ideation to launch.
  • Build a product and strategy that reflect Insider One’s vision, clearly articulating business value to align the team around each release.
  • Own and optimize the release process, coordinating all activities to bring products to market successfully.
  • Manage and prioritize initiatives, turning insights into actionable ideas by continuously tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies.
  • Define and analyze key product metrics to measure performance, customer satisfaction, and improvement opportunities.

    • What You Will Need
  • A Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university, preferably in Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with a B2B SaaS product.
  • Hands-on experience in Agile Product Development.
  • Exceptional decision-making and communication skills.
  • The ability to manage complex initiatives with limited supervision.
  • Fluent in English and Turkish, both written and verbal, as we have colleagues from all over the world.

    • What We Offer
  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
  • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.

    To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
     
    If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

data.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust und betreibst unsere n8n-Automationen und verbindest CRM, Customer-Support-Tools, E-Mail und Kalender zu nahtlosen Workflows – von der KI-gestützten Ticket-Klassifizierung über intelligentes Eskalations-Routing bis hin zu automatischen Benachrichtigungen bei kritischen Ereignissen.
  • Du entwickelst Automationslogik und Workflow-Regeln in unserem Support-Tool und sorgst dafür, dass unser Eskalationsmodell technisch sauber abgebildet und Informationen zuverlässig zwischen den Systemen synchronisiert werden.
  • Du integrierst KI-Bausteine dort in unsere Automationen, wo sie echten Zeitgewinn und Mehrwert schaffen. Gleichzeitig denkst du Datenschutz und Datenminimierung von Anfang an mit: Welche Daten an ein Modell übermittelt werden dürfen und welche nicht, ist für dich Teil eines guten Designs.
  • Du baust mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein statt nach dem Prinzip „ship and pray“: Neue Flows werden zunächst inaktiv getestet, mit realistischen Testfällen geprüft und mit Deduplication-Logik, Fallbacks und Fehlerbehandlung ausgestattet, bevor sie produktiv gehen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Operations und Customer Success zusammen, übersetzt operative Pain Points in konkrete, robuste Automationen und kommunizierst proaktiv und transparent, wo ein Flow steht und warum etwas gegebenenfalls länger dauert.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder Cursor selbstverständlich als Hebel, um schneller zu bauen, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und Dinge umzusetzen, die du ohne diese Werkzeuge vielleicht gar nicht entwickelt hättest.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Workflow-Automation – idealerweise mit n8n, Zapier oder Make – oder kommst aus der Backend-Entwicklung und bringst einen starken Fokus auf APIs und System-Integrationen mit. (Required)
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit REST-APIs und Webhooks, liest und debuggst JSON-Payloads ohne Umwege und findest schnell die Ursache, wenn ein Integrationsflow nicht das tut, was er soll.
  • Erfahrung mit dem Zoho-Ökosystem (CRM, Desk) ist ein großes Plus. Deluge-Scripting ist kein Muss – wichtiger ist deine Bereitschaft, dich schnell und selbstständig einzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie man KI-Bausteine wie Klassifizierung oder Textgenerierung robust in produktive Workflows integriert – und weißt gleichzeitig, wo die Grenzen von Automatisierung liegen und welche Entscheidungen besser beim Menschen bleiben.
  • Du bringst solide Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript oder Python mit, um bei Bedarf Custom-Code-Nodes zu entwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und sicherheitsbewusst: Du denkst an Testfälle vor der Aktivierung, Fallbacks im Fehlerfall und eine gute Nachvollziehbarkeit, damit auch andere deine Flows später problemlos verstehen und warten können.
  • Du kommunizierst proaktiv und klar – auch dann, wenn etwas länger dauert oder nicht wie geplant läuft. Operations und Customer Success können sich auf dich als verlässlichen Partner verlassen.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude und Cursor gerne als Produktivitäts-Booster, um schneller zu arbeiten, neue Lösungen auszuprobieren und bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1).


Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibel arbeiten: 2 Tage Home Office, 3 Tage im Büro und Vertrauensarbeitszeit geben dir Flexibilität und gleichzeitig eine klare gemeinsame Struktur.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub + Workation: Neben 30 Urlaubstagen hast du an Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag zusätzlich frei. Außerdem kannst du nach Absprache bis zu eine Woche pro Jahr aus der EU, dem EWR oder der Schweiz arbeiten.
  • Company Bike: Lease dein Wunschrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen und nutze es auch privat. Rundum-Schutz ist inklusive. Optional kannst du auch ein zweites Bike für deine:n Partner:in leasen.
  • 50 € monatlich on top: Du erhältst jeden Monat einen steuerfreien Benefit von 50 € bei mindestens 30 Std./Woche bzw. 25 € bei weniger als 30 Std./Woche. Den Betrag kannst du flexibel einsetzen.
  • Rabatte & Vergünstigungen: Profitiere von 15 % OBI-Personalrabatt, zahlreichen Angeboten über das Corporate Benefits Portal und exklusiven Rabatten bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken.
  • Alles für deinen Arbeitsalltag: Ein MacBook der neuesten Generation, Call-Zones, Quiet-Zones und Phoneboxes bieten dir das passende Setup für konzentriertes Arbeiten. Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine, Getränke und frisches Obst stehen ebenfalls für dich bereit.
  • Zeit fürs Team: Zweiwöchentliches Breakfast, Afterwork Drinks, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier. Wir schaffen regelmäßig Gelegenheiten, um auch abseits des Arbeitsalltags gemeinsam Zeit zu verbringen.
  • Dogs welcome: Dein bürotauglicher Hund ist bei uns im Office herzlich willkommen.


Unser Interview Prozess

  • Kennenlern-Call (30 Min.) – Ein erstes Gespräch via Google Meet mit unserer People & Culture Managerin Monika. Bring erste Fragen mit und sag uns, weshalb du dich für eine Mitarbeit bei uns begeisterst.

  • Case Study & Fachinterview (ca. 45 Min.) – Vor dem zweiten Gespräch erhältst du einen Case, den du eigenständig bearbeitest. Im anschließenden Termin besprichst du deine Lösung gemeinsam mit Tom und Vytautas. Dabei gehen wir tiefer auf deine fachlichen Kompetenzen, deine Herangehensweise an analytische Fragestellungen sowie deine Denk- und Arbeitsweise ein. Natürlich bleibt auch ausreichend Raum für deine fachlichen Fragen.


Gleiche Chancen für alle

Bei 42watt leben wir eine offene und inklusive Unternehmenskultur. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Diversität und Gleichberechtigung der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg sind. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, das Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt auf allen Ebenen unterstützt. Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Menschen aller Geschlechter, kulturellen Hintergründe, Altersgruppen und Fähigkeiten, sich zu bewerben. Unser Ziel ist es, ein diverses Team zu formen, das unsere Werte verkörpert und kreative Ideen vorantreibt.

Capmo is the digital partner on construction sites, with over 100k projects delivered faster and more successfully with the help of our platform. Help us continue to revolutionize the industry! Find out more about us and come join us in our engineering hubs in Berlin and Munich.

As a Senior Security Engineer at Capmo, you will get to:

  • own product and cloud security end to end — threat modeling, security reviews, secure-by-default patterns, and the tooling in our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, dependency and container scanning, secret detection) that keeps findings from piling up.

  • harden our AWS infrastructure: IAM architecture, network segmentation, encryption, logging, workload security — and encode the baselines as policy-as-code instead of a wiki page nobody reads.

  • build our detection and response capability from the ground up, and be the technical lead when something actually happens — from detection through containment to the post-incident review.

  • own our vulnerability disclosure and pentest programs, and drive remediation with the product teams rather than filing tickets and hoping.

  • back our compliance work (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR) with real technical controls and evidence, and support customer security reviews together with Sales.

  • shape the direction of security at Capmo as a hands-on senior IC — building guardrails that engineers adopt because they're good, not because they're mandated.


What we offer

  • Become a shareholder: Take part in our success with our employee stock option program (VSOP).
  • Grow fast: Benefit from an annual development budget of €1,000 and two Development Days to invest in your personal and professional growth.
  • Fitness, food or mobility budget? With EGYM Wellpass, you get unlimited access to 90+ gyms and swimming pools in Germany – or choose a lunch subsidy or a mobility budget as your preferred benefit. 
  • Think ahead: We contribute 20% to your company pension plan. (only applicable in Germany)
  • Hybrid work model: We work in a hybrid setup — 3 days together in the office and 2 days wherever you work best.
  • Exceptional Team: Join a talented and diverse team with limitless growth opportunities.
  • Culture Day Off: Take a day off for essential occasions.


What you bring along

  • 7+ years of hands-on security engineering, including several years owning application and cloud security for a production SaaS platform end to end.

  • A track record of building security programs — SDLC, vulnerability management, detection and response — not just operating tools someone else set up.

  • Expert-level understanding of vulnerability classes and attack techniques well beyond the OWASP Top 10: you can threat-model a new feature, spot the subtle authz flaw in review, and explain the exploit path to the engineer who wrote it.

  • Deep experience hardening cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS ideally, GCP or Azure fine): IAM, network segmentation, container security, security-as-code — designed by you, not inherited.

  • Strong software engineering skills — you write production-quality code, build automation from scratch, and hold your own in architecture discussions with senior engineers.

  • Proven incident response leadership: you've been the technical lead when things went wrong.

  • The judgment to make risk-based calls under ambiguity, and the influence to get teams to act on them without formal authority.

  • Excellent English; German is a plus. Willingness to be on-site 3 days per week in Munich or Berlin.

Nice to have: building up a security function in a scale-up, detection engineering, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 certification experience, certs like OSCP or CISSP (valued, but hands-on skills matter more).

data.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.

You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.

You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.

What you'll do

  • Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

  • Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

  • Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

  • Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

What we're looking for

  • Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

  • You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

  • You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

  • You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

What sets you apart

  • You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

  • You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

  • You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

That's what we're building at Montu.

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right.

As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD), you will be responsible for carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions before they are supplied to patients. You will act as an independent safeguard within the dispensing process, ensuring that medicines are assembled exactly as prescribed and in line with legal, operational and patient safety standards.

Getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will be trusted to exercise professional judgement, identify risks before they become incidents, and have the confidence to stop the process whenever something does not look right.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed medicines, confirming that the product supplied matches the prescription and accompanying documentation.

  • Verifying the right patient, right medicine, right strength, right formulation, right quantity and right directions, ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate.

  • Checking that medicines have been assembled in accordance with legal requirements, SOPs and company processes.

  • Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors immediately, supporting a culture of openness and continuous improvement.

  • Maintaining clear, accurate and auditable records of all checks completed.

  • Exercising professional judgement and recognising when concerns fall outside your scope of practice, referring to the Responsible Pharmacist where appropriate.

  • Supporting the safe handling and checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and high-risk medications, in accordance with relevant legislation and internal procedures.

  • Ensuring appropriate expiry date checks, batch number verification (where applicable), and packaging integrity checks are completed before supply.

  • Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries efficiently while maintaining independence during the final checking process.

  • Contributing to quality assurance initiatives, investigations and process improvements aimed at reducing dispensing errors and improving patient safety.

  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues, helping to embed a culture of accountability, quality and attention to detail.

  • Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking.

What do you need?

  • An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice.

  • Significant experience working within a pharmacy environment with a proven track record of conducting final accuracy checks.

  • A detailed understanding of the dispensing process and the critical control points that prevent medication errors.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles.

  • The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace.

  • Confidence to challenge discrepancies and halt the supply process when patient safety could be compromised.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A proactive mindset, taking ownership of issues and following them through to resolution.

  • A genuine commitment to patient outcomes — understanding that every prescription represents a person relying on you to get it right.

What we offer:

  • Full-time contract: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, & Saturdays as either overtime or on a shift basis.

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base.

You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem.

This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio.

  • Co-create sales plays tailored to each partner’s customer base, vertical focus, and services capabilities. Author Working Backwards outcome proposals for strategic partner-customer combinations that translate AI Development Infrastructure into deal-level urgency.

  • Develop and deliver workshops, Builder Labs, and partner-hosted enablement sessions as the primary awareness and demand generation vehicle for the EMEA ecosystem. Build hands-on demonstration environments and interactive experiences that partners can use independently.

  • Intervene directly on the highest-value partner-attached deals across EMEA: co-sell calls, technical discovery, PoV scoping, architecture review, and technical win support. Own the engagement until the partner’s team can carry it independently.

  • Transform bespoke partner enablement sessions into structured LMS modules and certification tiers that scale across the EMEA partner base without requiring live PDE support for each new partner.

  • Produce “better together” reference architectures for strategic partner combinations across cloud providers and AI platforms. Include deployment diagrams, network topology, IAM patterns, and operational runbooks that partner SAs can hand directly to customers.

  • Codify each successful partner engagement into a repeatable GTM play: trigger conditions, discovery questions, positioning framework, demo script, PoV scope template, and expected outcomes. Build a playbook library that a new PDE or partner seller can pick up and run.

  • Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder.

  • Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from EMEA engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.

  • Own the EMEA-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. Define priorities cross-functionally with Product and Engineering based on field signals from the EMEA market.

  • Create and publish Partner Relations content, the ecosystem equivalent of Developer Relations: technical blog posts, cookbooks, partner ecosystem conference talks, enablement videos, and workshop recaps. Build Coder’s technical brand within the EMEA partner community.

  • Contribute to cloud marketplace product listing stewardship, competency maintenance documentation, and CSP co-build technical requirements as they apply to EMEA-specific partner and compliance contexts.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in a combination of Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Field CTO, Technical Consulting, or Developer Relations roles at an infrastructure, developer tools, or AI company

  • Demonstrated experience helping partners or customers understand and adopt products in emerging or undefined categories, not just executing playbooks for established ones

  • Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure), with production-level Kubernetes and Terraform depth. You have done the work and can speak to it with specificity.

  • 2+ years deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in a European enterprise context

  • Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security, compliance, or data sovereignty stakeholder

  • Experience working with channel or technology partners in a co-sell model: hyperscaler partner programs, GSI/RSI partnerships, or VAR/distributor ecosystems in EMEA markets

  • Experience building repeatable technical GTM assets that scaled beyond your personal delivery: sales plays, enablement curricula, reference architectures, or technical content programs

  • Executive communication and Field CTO credibility: you can hold a technical vision conversation with a partner CTO and a deal-level architecture review with an SE in the same day, in English and ideally at least one additional European language

  • Strong written communication: you can produce a Working Backwards PR/FAQ, a technical architecture document, and a blog post without those being separate skills requiring separate people

  • Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy. You will define processes that don’t exist, build tools that haven’t been scoped, and create a function from first principles in a new region.

Bonus Points

(Bonus tacos? That’s how we say thanks at Coder. Ask us about it.)

  • Prior Forward Deployed Engineer experience at a platform company (Palantir, Scale AI, frontier AI lab, or equivalent embedded deployment model)

  • Track record of public technical advocacy: blog posts, conference talks, open-source contributions, or developer/partner community engagement

  • Experience with hyperscaler partner programs (e.g., ISV Accelerate, strategic collaboration agreements, co-sell programs) at an operational level

  • Familiarity with European regulatory environments: GDPR, DORA, NIS2, AI Act compliance requirements, and data sovereignty patterns for cloud-native deployments

  • Experience with air-gapped or network-isolated deployments common in European financial services, government, or defense contexts

  • Background in AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

  • Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

  • Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

  • Open-source contributions, particularly in CNCF, MCP, or AI agent ecosystems

  • Existing relationships with hyperscaler EMEA solutions architecture teams, European GSI technical practices, or AI infrastructure partner ecosystems

  • Fluency in German, French, or a Nordic language in addition to English

What Success Looks Like

  • You have done the hard technical work before: deploying cloud-native infrastructure, navigating Kubernetes in production, building with Terraform, and operating in the complexity of large European enterprise environments. You bring that credibility into every partner conversation.

  • You are as invested in the pattern behind the engagement as you are in the engagement itself. Every bespoke partner interaction produces a reusable artifact. Every field insight feeds back to product. You codify by instinct.

  • You make the ecosystem and the product better: your field experience shapes how Coder builds integrations, how partners deliver, and how the EMEA market understands AI Development Infrastructure as a category.

Location: Remote EMEA (UK preferred)

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

This is a hard requirement, not a bonus. Candidates whose actual daily workflow does not already include AI tooling will not be advanced.

  • First-principles + decision-making. Demonstrated ability to Challenge the status quo, proactively identify systemic weaknesses, and propose innovative solutions to complex reliability problems — reason from constraints and failure modes (not analogy or vendor defaults), name the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off), and reject the "best practices" answer when it doesn't fit the problem.

  • Reversibility & blast-radius. Make reversible calls by default — write the rollback before you touch production, work fluently with monitoring and logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or equivalent), and stress the system in safe places so it comes back stronger.

Non-technical

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a talent for building strong relationships and Connecting with cross-functional teams — surface non-goals before anyone asks, and partner with product, security, and platform peers as one delivery surface.

  • Autonomy & end-to-end ownership. A strong sense of ownership and accountability, eager to Own mission-critical systems and drive them toward peak performance and unparalleled reliability. At least one 0-to-1 infrastructure build you owned end-to-end, with the outcome metric attached.

🎁 Bonus if you have

  • Software-engineering depth. A software-engineering background, not only config and scripting — you've designed, built, and shipped non-trivial production code (services, libraries, internal frameworks) in Python, Go, or a comparable language, you can read and modify the codebases your infrastructure runs, and you move between infra automation and feature engineering without changing brains.

Business Development Manager - Bristol

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to join our Bristol & South West team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Bristol and the South West region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the South West and Wales.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.

  • Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.

  • Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.

  • Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.

  • Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.

  • Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.

  • Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.

  • Mobility: A valid driving licence and access to a car are required, as you will be frequently travelling across Bristol and the surrounding areas.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.description:
About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

About the role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution - this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.

Typical problems you'll solve:

  • What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

  • How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

  • How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

  • Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

  • How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll be doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

  • Cross-functional delivery - partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

  • Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline - evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

  • Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

  • Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

  • Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

  • Communicate to senior stakeholders - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations - ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech.

  • Commercial acumen: strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call - you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what."

  • Bias for action and ownership: able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend.

  • Cross-functional influence: track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication - able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in London.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

  • Lead technically complex initiatives across areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

  • Translate ambiguous business and merchant problems into scalable, pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Drive technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term product needs.

  • Own systems and initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and design through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and engineers across teams to align on solutions and delivery.

  • Support and mentor other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining strong judgment around correctness, security, maintainability, and quality.

  • Work comfortably outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve problems end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production.

  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas.

  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating production software at scale in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments.

  • Experience owning complex features, services, or technical initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

  • Strong understanding of system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, observability, and production reliability.

  • Experience making technical and architectural decisions where there are multiple valid approaches and meaningful trade-offs.

  • A track record of helping other engineers grow through mentoring, technical guidance, code reviews, or knowledge sharing.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

 

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

  • Integrations with external business systems.

  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.

  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe.

The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

The hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

  1. Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent. You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.

  2. System design session with our engineering team. No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.

  3. Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in Europe with quarterly trips to London.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally
